Hey there, wanted to pop in and ask for some plobby feedback here since there's hopefully some frequent plobby users in here.

I am working on a future patch where we want to improve plobbies, fix some rough edges, finish features we left half-cooked on first release, and try to add some features to help out community tournaments.

Here's a few things we've got on our radar already:
- Fixing the ready check (making it not useless)
- Allowing non-party leaders to be invited to plobbies (party leader still needs to approve the join)
- Allowing joining plobbies mid-game
- Changing plobby leader
- Systems for auto-shuffling players/specs & auto-kicking offline players on re-queue
- Adding a way to stop a plobby game
- Adding basic per-game settings (we have some big technical limitations in this area but I'd like to find some things we can add already, e.g. 2 team BB mode)
- Possibly some way to set team colors

Are there any other features / fixes / annoyances to solve that we should look out for? Is there anything that makes the system frustrating / inconvenient right now that we could improve?
(feel free to ping me when replying btw)
